infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RentLK needs camera access to capture KYC documents and vehicle photos.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RentLK needs photo library access to upload vehicle images and documents.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RentLK needs location access to show nearby vehicles and enable tracking.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysUsageDescription: RentLK needs background location for vehicle tracking during active rentals.
infoPlist.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: RentLK uses Face ID for secure authentication and payment confirmation.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RentLK needs microphone access for voice messages in chat.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow RentLK to access your camera for KYC verification and vehicle photos.

plugins.photosPermission: Allow RentLK to access your photos for vehicle images and KYC documents.

plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Allow RentLK to use your location for vehicle search and tracking.
